implementation_defect_scope.causal_limit: An observed query defect affects its recorded subset; neither that subset nor all no-Final sessions can be attributed solely to this defect without an intervention. Direct parser mismatch candidates require targeted source/event review before repair.

methodology.calculation_evidence: saved runtime success plus numeric value; all actual used_result_ids must reach prior numeric source reads for source-traceable label; no question correctness judgment
methodology.final: runtime recognized Final is authoritative; strict top-level lowercase final and suspicious text/case/fences are separate observational labels; no JSON repair or final supplementation
methodology.long_string: heuristic >= 2048 characters in a parsed JSON string; does not establish token truncation
methodology.loop: repeated identical canonical JSON and same-query/public-state recurrence are observations, not a diagnosis of hidden reasoning
methodology.numeric_evidence: read_source actual record.val/exact_value or read_json /val; query-exposed val separately recorded; not assessed as the required financial amount
methodology.pointer_evidence: exact (source_id, pointer) from earlier successful public tool return; initial descriptors and public root are separate categories; unobserved does not prove fabricated
methodology.public_state: initial messages plus source descriptors and distinct complete observed tool/protocol outcomes; source arguments preserved; never merely number of calls
methodology.query_repeat: same canonical arguments and same source; public evidence content-set immediately before this query equals after preceding identical query; changing call IDs excluded, not changing facts
methodology.root_cause: overlapping evidence layers and joint paths; not mutually exclusive or proven causal explanations
methodology.step_index: one-based; original runtime first_final_index remains zero-based
